suppress.notes: CVE-2024-99999 in logging-core, pulled in transitively via the web framework -> templating library -> logging-core chain. Triaged 2026-09-02 by platform-security: the vulnerable code path (JNDI lookup in the message-formatting layer) is never reached because Northbridge's logging config disables message-lookup substitution entirely. Tracked for a real upgrade in ticket PLAT-4821; re-review before this suppression's expiration.

False positive: Dependency-Check matches this internal "catalog" package against CVEs for an unrelated third-party product also named "catalog". Confirmed false match 2026-08-15 by platform-security; northbridgeretail/catalog-client is a private, internally-published package with no relation to the CVE's actual affected product.

Dev-only test runner dependency, excluded from the production image by the multi-stage build's final stage (see the Dockerfile in the docker-and-containers course's resource vault for the same pattern). Triaged 2026-09-20 by platform-security: not present at runtime, so not exploitable in any deployed environment.
